# Schreiberei München

> Two restaurants in one historic house at Burgstraße 5 in Munich's old town (Altstadt): Tohru in der Schreiberei, the three-Michelin-star restaurant of chef Tohru Nakamura, and Bar Tatar, a bar and restaurant built around tartare and drinks. Both are operated by Ensemble Culinaire GmbH.

The building dates back to the 14th century. It was rebuilt in stone after Munich's great fire of 1327 and acquired by the city in 1550.

## Tohru in der Schreiberei

- Website (English): https://www.schreiberei-muc.de/tohru
- Cuisine: seasonal tasting menu blending Japanese, German and French cuisines, shaped by chef Tohru Nakamura's German-Japanese heritage and the philosophy of kaiseki
- Awards: three Michelin stars; member of Les Grandes Tables du Monde
- Tasting menu: €380 per person; wine, sake and non-alcoholic pairings available
- Guests: 30 per evening; the experience takes about 3.5 hours
- Opening hours: Tuesday to Saturday from 7 pm, last arrival 8 pm; closed on Sundays and Mondays
- Reservations: https://www.opentable.de/r/tohru-fine-dining-reservations-munchen?restref=216039
- Address: Burgstraße 5, 80331 München, Germany (first floor of a heritage-listed building)
- Phone: +49 89 21529172 (Tuesday to Saturday, 2 to 6 pm)
- Email: kontakt@schreiberei-muc.de
- Team: Tohru Nakamura (Chef), Dominik Schmid (Head Chef), Stefan Fluch (Sous Chef), Christian Rainer (Maître Sommelier), Bernd Großschädl (Restaurant Manager)
- Events: Cooking with Tohru, a Sunday cooking class from 11:30 am to 6:30 pm, €495 per person: https://www.schreiberei-muc.de/tohru#events
- Gift vouchers: https://www.schreiberei-muc.de/tohru#gift
- Menu: https://www.schreiberei-muc.de/tohru#menu
- Menu PDF (English): https://www.schreiberei-muc.de/Menu-Tohru-EN.pdf
- Menu PDF (German): https://www.schreiberei-muc.de/Menu-Tohru-DE.pdf

## Bar Tatar

- Website (German): https://www.schreiberei-muc.de/bar-tatar
- Concept: a bar where tartare plays the lead, with beef, fish and vegetarian variations, starters, specials, oysters and cocktails; relaxed, no dress code
- Opening hours: Tuesday to Friday 5 pm to 1 am, Saturday 1 pm to 1 am; closed on Sundays and Mondays
- Kitchen hours: Tuesday to Friday 5 pm to 10 pm, Saturday 1 pm to 10 pm
- Reservations: https://www.opentable.de/r/schreiberei-reservations-munchen?restref=272529
- Address: Burgstraße 5, 80331 München, Germany (ground floor; second entrance at Dienerstraße 20)
- Phone: +49 89 21529173 (Tuesday to Friday 3 pm to 11 pm, Saturday 12 pm to 11 pm)
- Email: ml@schreiberei-muc.de
- Menu with prices: https://www.schreiberei-muc.de/bar-tatar#menu
- Menu PDF (German): https://www.schreiberei-muc.de/Menu-BarTatar.pdf
- Gift vouchers: https://www.schreiberei-muc.de/bar-tatar#gift
